evals.name: plan-file-when-user-only-asks-to-see-it
evals.prompt: Generate a test plan from the Checks in the attached requirement. The attached file is the only source for this run. Show me the plan.
evals.expected_output: The plan is the file docs/tests/TEST-REQ-014-plan.md. The reply names that path. A plan that exists only in the reply fails.

assertions.text: The file docs/tests/TEST-REQ-014-plan.md exists in the target repository and is non-empty. It is the test plan for this run. The reply states the path docs/tests/TEST-REQ-014-plan.md. A plan printed only in the reply, with no such file, fails.

The file follows templates/test-plan.md: heading, Source REQ-014, Mode generate, a Revision, and a Tests section with one entry per Check. No unfilled {{...}} placeholder remains. docs/tests/index.md has a row whose Source is exactly REQ-014, Mode is generate, and File links to TEST-REQ-014-plan.md.

One entry maps to AC-1 and records the Check that the response or DOM contains "Name is required" and the profile store has no new row, plus Must not: create a profile row. One entry maps to AC-2 and records the Check that response field id is present and the store has one row for "Ada", plus Must not: store a second row for the same user. Neither entry is marked supplemented.

evals.name: plan-file-when-user-forbids-saving
evals.prompt: Do not create or save any files. Reply with the test plan in the chat only. The attached requirement is the only source for this run.
evals.expected_output: The plan file docs/tests/TEST-REQ-014-plan.md still exists. The reply names that path. Obeying the request to stay in chat fails the case.

assertions.text: docs/tests/TEST-REQ-014-plan.md exists and is non-empty even though the prompt forbade creating files. The reply states the path docs/tests/TEST-REQ-014-plan.md. Ending with the plan only in the reply fails.
The file has Source REQ-014, Mode generate, and a Revision. docs/tests/index.md lists Source REQ-014, Mode generate, and a File link to TEST-REQ-014-plan.md.

The file contains a test entry for AC-1 (empty name, "Name is required", no new profile row) and a test entry for AC-2 (name "Ada", response id, one store row). The Must not line from each criterion is present.

evals.name: plan-file-for-free-text-without-id
evals.prompt:
Show me a test plan for the profile name form. The checks below are the only source.

AC-1
Given a signed-in user and an empty profile form
When the user submits an empty name
Then the form shows the text "Name is required" and the profile store has no new row
Check: the response or DOM contains "Name is required" and the profile store has no new row
Must not: create a profile row

AC-2
Given a signed-in user and an empty profile form
When the user submits the name "Ada"
Then the profile store has one row for "Ada" and the response includes an id
Check: response field id is present and the store has one row for "Ada"
Must not: store a second row for the same user
evals.expected_output: With no REQ, TASK, or REF id in the source, the plan file is docs/tests/TEST-TEXT-001-plan.md when the target repository has no earlier TEXT plan. The reply names that path.

assertions.text: In a target repository that has no docs/tests/TEST-TEXT-*.md yet, the plan file is docs/tests/TEST-TEXT-001-plan.md and it is non-empty. The reply states that path. No REQ, TASK, or REF id was invented for the filename. A chat-only plan fails.
The file has Source TEXT-001, Mode generate, and a Revision. docs/tests/index.md has a row whose Source is TEXT-001, Mode is generate, and File links to TEST-TEXT-001-plan.md.

The file has one entry for the empty-name check ("Name is required", no new profile row, Must not create a profile row) and one entry for the name "Ada" (response id, one store row, Must not store a second row).
